outcome: Severity of HIE (based on brain MRI)
cohort: 83 infants diagnosed with asphyxia in a neonatal intensive care unit from January 2014 to June 2021
finding: Therapeutic hypothermia can increase blood hs-CRP levels in neonates with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE), and the probability of hs-CRP elevation is related to the severity of HIE.
